nom: DRMTLGY Tingl Exfoliating Face & Body Pads 60 Count

avis.texte: Update: I've been using 1 pad every morning. I started a heavy peel on day 4 and as soon as I applied the pad, my skin started to burn. It was very uncomfortable but didn't create any redness. It took about 2 minutes for my face to calm down. The next morning the burning was present but not nearly as bad and it didn't last as long. I also found that the pads don't work well on heavy peel days 😞. I'll limit use to only dry, flakey days. I'm still happy with the product. I use RetinA/Tretinoin .1% for age spots so the skin on my face goes through frequent episodes of heavy peeling & flaking. My skin is borderline sensitive. I've tried several methods of exfoliation & moisturization, but I'm always left with flakey looking/scaly feeling skin. That said, I just passed a heavy peeling stage and my face is covered in tiny, stubborn flakes, and the jar of Tingl exfoliating pads just arrived...great timing 😀 So I ran to the bathroom, washed my face, and gave it a try. I'm VERY happy with the results. 1) The jar arrived in excellent condition. The lid was tightly secured, the jar was not sealed with a waterproof barrier but the pads are very moist; 2) The pads are a little small but sturdy and handled 3 passes of light circular rubbing over my entire face & neck; 3) There's a very light, citrus odor that didn't linger; 4) It took about 2 hours for the sticky feeling to be fully absorbed. The humidity is a little high where I am so maybe it won't take that long in lower humidity; 5)

I had very pronounced pores and wrinkles due to a skin condition and I spent $4,000 a year and a half ago for a deep laser treatment which took me a year to recover from. The deep laser was painful during the treatment, my face hurt for a solid week afterward, and then my face was seeping fluids along with blood spots, and swelling for 6 weeks, They said that I should continue to see improvements over the next 12 months but once healed I only rate the effects at about 25% of what I would have expected... I purchased the tingl Face and Body Exfoliator and after two weeks of use, I felt I was seeing more benefits from this product than I realized from the $4,000 treatment. The pads are easy to use, and I can feel the effects of the product on my skin after wiping carefully with the pads. Normally, my skin is classified as sensitive but is handling the tingl product well. I will buy this product again.

This stuff scares me a bit but my olive toned skin likes to showcase all my dryness and so my skin ends up looking flaky, thick, and gray which is no bueno. I want to look like a glowy goddess not a cast away from a Tim Burton movie. So because I’m a sucker for girl math and free money I used my FSA to purchase these exfoliater pads. And I’m very glad I did! They smell super medicinal and if you have open blemishes on your face this is going to burn the soul out of your body. However used correctly I swipe them over my face after cleansing and follow with everything else. But I always wake up with smooth, bright skin! It clears up acne for me and make my skin looks soft, hydrated, and even the next morning! It’s definitely going on my rotation.

avis.titre: Smooth, Clear, and Glowy—These Pads Work Fast
avis.texte: I’ve been using the DRMTLGY Tingl Exfoliating Pads for about a month now, and I’m honestly impressed with how well they work without being harsh. I use them about 2–3 times a week, mostly at night after cleansing. You definitely feel a little tingle when you swipe the pad across your skin, but it’s not painful or irritating—just enough to know it’s doing something. My skin looks brighter and smoother the next morning every time I use one. My pores are visibly smaller, and the little bumps I get on my forehead and jawline are way less noticeable. I’ve also used them on my chest and shoulders where I sometimes get breakouts, and they help there too. The formula has a good balance of glycolic, lactic, and salicylic acid, but it also feels calming—my skin never feels stripped or dry afterward. The pads themselves are thick and well-soaked, and one is enough for my whole face and neck, or even spot-treating other areas. They haven’t caused any irritation, and I’ve had fewer breakouts and blackheads since adding them to my routine. If you’re looking for an easy way to exfoliate and clear up texture or congestion without overdoing it, these are a solid pick. Just make sure to follow up with sunscreen the next day, because they definitely make your skin more sensitive to the sun. Overall, these are a repeat buy for me.

Seems to be doing the trick. In the beginning I did have a couple patches of dry and peeling skin. But it did say to stop everyday usage if this occurs so your skin can get adjusted to it. It tingles a bit which kind of feels refreshing yet alarming if that makes sense. Borderline didn’t know if it’s supposed to sting THAT MUCH, but I felt better after a few times. My face does feel clarified and stripped of dirt and extra sebum after usage. And has helped my oily skin. It be so oily.

Such a good product. It encourages to build up to 2x daily use, but I got results with twice/ wk. I think it would dry me out if I did, but I know everyone is different. If you are adding this into a routine with a retinol/retinal use on different days! I’m 34 and it evened out my tone, changed texture and cleared any breakouts. I don’t have any major lines or wrinkles so I can’t speak to that. Worth the purchase. Wear sunscreen!

I like these. They definitely feel like they're working but there's a weird residue afterwards that makes my skin feel funny. However, they definitely deep clean. Not a bad item for the price, but I'm not sure I'd purchase again.

These pads are amazing and they are my holy grail to smoothing my face from painful inflamed pimples and the keratosis pilaris on arms! After years of suffering from tkeratosis pilaris on the back of my arms and spending hundred of dollars, I accidentally discovered that these are the answer. I used a pad for my face and it had extra moisture so I wiped it on my arms. Next morning, my arms were smooth. I used it for 3 nights in a row and my arms cleared up! -----Regarding the inflamed pimples, which I get once in a blue moon, it soothes the pain and pimple overnight. It is awesome! Unfortunately, It's not qualify under HSA/FSA anymore so I'm a bit sad. I'm going to have to wait to buy a new bottle soon. If you're struggling with keratosis pilaris, I hope these work for you as it did for me.

avis.titre: Amazing for exfoliating I can’t recommend enough
avis.texte: These are worth the money 10000% they have helped my acne a ton. I learned you’re supposed to actually scrub and exfoliate with them, and even when I thought my face was clean, it will still be grayish from getting off dry skin or leftover makeup. Also helped my bumps/blackheads a TON I recommend these to everyone. My acne before (a few years ago) and now
Love it. I'm 66 & look fairly good for my age but my face was bumpy uneven texture. I've tried different exfoliating products with some success but this is a game changer! Oh best part? FSA covered.

avis.titre: Gentle Exfoliation on My Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: These Tingl pads from DRMTLGY are an easy way to help me to exfoliate my skin. The waffle weave textured pads are soft and well moistened. I find them to be gentle and non abrasive on my sensitive skin. Using both sides of the pad, I'm able to address my entire face. I felt no tingle and/or sensation with this product's formulation upon application. It's rather gentle. After using the pad and allowing the product to completely be absorbed and dry on my skin, I do find there is a slight tacky feeling left behind on my face. That being said, it's not enough of a residue that it would stop me from using this product. As one who uses retinol nightly, I'm very happy that this exfoliating product doesn't irritate me and fits in comfortably with my skin care routine. I can't speak to long-term anti aging results as that takes time and consistency, but I can share that my face feels cleaner after use. I can appreciate that fact by seeing skin debris that's evident on a pad after use. I've posted some photos to give you a closer look at this product and sincerely hope that they, along with my experience, help you out a bit with your choice . Thank you.

The first time using these exfoliating wipes they gave me a burning sensation on my face. Not sure if it was just these wipes or the combination of the face wash I used and the wipes. The next day I used a more mild face wash and the burning sensation was less. The bottle did say to give it time for your skin to get used to it. I do feel like my face feels cleaner when using these exfoliating wipes. I think they would be better using every other day since they are a little harsh.

avis.titre: After the 1st use my face was so clean.
avis.texte: From the 1st day it removed oil and dirt from my face. It feels so silky smooth after I use it. I only need one pad a night before i go to bed. I liked that it did not burn my skin or sting like some of these exfoliating pads do.

I had high hopes for these cleansing pads, but unfortunately, they didn’t work well for my skin. After just a few days of use, my face started to feel very dry and irritated. Even after several weeks, I didn’t notice any real improvement in my skin’s texture or clarity. They also caused a tingling and burning sensation, which was uncomfortable. I also found that my skin became more sensitive to the sun. Overall, not worth it, I won’t be repurchasing.

This product IS SO HARSH! It burns your skin raw! Buyer beware! I will not ever buy again! This stuff made my skin look like I had a chemical peel burn or some sort of sunburn on my forehead and my upper lip! It was red, itchy and now flaky and super dry!. Having to buy moisturizing products to heal it cause it was so bad

avis.titre: Left me broken out all over
avis.texte: Two weeks in and this is what my face looks like. I am completely broken out in these red bumps all over my forehead. This is the only new item I’ve introduced into my skincare.
I have sensitive skin, so if that is the case for you, do not buy this product. My whole face broke out in hives and pimples, hated what it did to my face 😡

⚠️ I very rarely write reviews but my experience with Drmtlgy products was so awful, I felt the need to caution others. It made my 41 year old skin break out so badly it was painful. I have not had acne since my 20s/teens thanks to a course of Acutane. The only change to my skincare was Drmtlgy. I bought the essential cleanser, Tingl pads, matte tinted moisturizer and under eye color corrector after the Instagram ads finally sucked me in. I immediately felt the "tingle" and not in a good way. It made my skin red and irritated. Within a few days I noticed pimples. I read that the skin may need time to "purge." I stuck it out for about 5-6 weeks until my skin got so bad that my kids asked me what I hit my head on due to the massive and painful zit on my forehead. Within a few days of stopping all Drmtlgy products my skin felt better and within a week redness and pimples were gone. I am confused by all the glowing reviews because I could not have had a worse experience. Do yourself a favor and save your money. 👎👎
